blocks.heading: Talent Acquisition AI
paragraphs: Chicago's competitive labor market for financial services, technology, manufacturing, and healthcare creates high-volume recruiting at companies like Accenture (major Chicago office), Abbott, Kraft Heinz, Boeing (Chicago HQ), and United Airlines:
Resume screening and skills matching: NLP extracting structured skills profiles from Chicago candidate applications and matching to role requirements with semantic precision beyond keyword filtering.
Candidate experience prediction: ML predicting which candidates will accept offers based on engagement signals, competitive dynamics, and role characteristics — enabling proactive offer strategy.

Talent sourcing intelligence: ML identifying passive candidate pools from LinkedIn and professional network data for Chicago's specialized talent markets (derivatives risk specialists, food science engineers, healthcare supply chain).
Cost: $45,000–$110,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks | Illinois EEOC / IHRC disparate impact context

blocks.heading: Workforce Planning and Attrition Prediction
paragraphs: For Chicago's large enterprise employers:

Voluntary attrition prediction: ML predicting employee departures 60–90 days ahead — incorporating engagement survey signals, performance trajectory, compensation relative to market, manager quality, and commute distance (Chicago's commute data is particularly predictive given traffic patterns).
Headcount forecasting: ML for demand-driven workforce planning — predicting headcount needs by function, geography, and skill based on business growth trajectories.
Internal mobility matching: ML recommending internal moves for Chicago employees whose skills and interests align with open roles — reducing external hiring cost and improving retention.
Cost: $45,000–$110,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks

blocks.heading: Compensation Analytics
paragraphs: Chicago's cost structure sits between coastal markets and smaller Midwest cities — creating compensation benchmarking challenges for organizations competing across the Chicago metropolitan area and nationally:
Market compensation benchmarking: ML synthesizing H-1B disclosure data, job posting compensation data, and survey benchmarks for real-time Chicago market compensation positioning.
Pay equity analysis: Statistical analysis identifying unexplained gender and race pay gaps for Chicago's corporations under Illinois Equal Pay Act requirements.
Total compensation optimization: ML modeling offer acceptance probability and employee satisfaction under different total compensation structures.
Cost: $40,000–$95,000 | Timeline: 10–18 weeks | Illinois Equal Pay Act

blocks.heading: DEI Analytics for Chicago's Corporate Community
paragraphs: Chicago's corporate community has made significant DEI commitments — AI to measure, track, and improve diversity outcomes:
Hiring funnel diversity analytics: ML analyzing where underrepresented candidates exit Chicago's recruiting processes — identifying specific stages and roles with disparate outcomes.
Promotion equity analysis: Statistical modeling identifying whether promotion rates across demographic groups reflect equivalent performance distributions.
Inclusion sentiment by segment: NLP analyzing Chicago employee survey data for differential inclusion experiences across demographic groups.
Cost: $40,000–$95,000 | Timeline: 10–18 weeks

sections.title: Illinois HR AI Regulatory Context
sections.description: Compliance frameworks embedded in every Chicago HR AI project.

blocks.heading: Illinois Human Rights Act (IHRC)
paragraphs: The IHRC prohibits employment discrimination and creates a state enforcement mechanism for employment AI bias. ClickMasters designs Chicago HR AI with IHRC disparate impact testing as a standard — identical to the approach ClickMasters uses for EEOC compliance but with Illinois-specific enforcement context.

blocks.heading: Illinois Biometric Information Privacy Act (BIPA)
paragraphs: Illinois's BIPA is the nation's strictest biometric privacy law — for any Chicago HR AI using voice biometrics (voice screening), face recognition (candidate verification), or behavioral biometrics, BIPA's explicit written consent requirements are mandatory. ClickMasters designs Chicago HR AI without biometric data unless BIPA consent infrastructure is specifically built.

blocks.heading: Illinois Equal Pay Act
paragraphs: Illinois's pay equity law creates specific documentation requirements for equal pay certification. ClickMasters delivers pay equity analysis methodology and results documentation appropriate for Illinois Equal Pay Act compliance.

items.question: Does Illinois BIPA affect our Chicago candidate screening AI?
items.answer: BIPA applies to biometric data (fingerprints, voiceprints, face geometry) — if candidate screening uses voice analysis or face recognition, BIPA's explicit written consent requirements apply. ClickMasters designs screening AI to avoid biometric data by default unless BIPA consent infrastructure is specifically built.
